scope: Development recalibration on all 160 exposed synthetic baseline cases; not independent validation
optimizer: Five SLSQP unrestricted starts; three fixed-truth starts; unchanged continuous interpolant
invalid: Optimizer failure, support failure, computational mean/exponent/upper-scatter boundary within 1e-5, or fixed-truth optimum beats unrestricted by more than 1e-6 in log likelihood. Zero scatter is allowed.
interval: Nominal chi-square(1) LR 95% membership, requires simulation calibration; not assumed correct at boundary
reporting: Every case retained, per-cell rates and binomial intervals, no selective replacement. Preserve frozen baseline. Hash-locked checkpoint resume.
limitations: Previously exposed cases; all observed-flux and physical causal claims remain untested. Subsequent fresh-seed calibration and width-grid sensitivity required.
